scope: Independent scipy EDT of same-generation inflated occupancy; XY crop margin>0.65m; complete native z; no synthetic occupied padding; actual source-stamped preceding odom and joints.
sphere_policy: 0-based indices; fixed spheres use native ground-frame z (odom.z is not added), hard radius=physical+0.05m for first47; arm radius as deployed. No dynamic layer included.
conclusion: Every checked same-generation field agrees with independently recomputed signed EDT within numerical precision.
caveat: Diagnostics at 1Hz are not guaranteed to be exactly the rejected-command generation. Occupied voxels are confirmed map state, not proof of real physical obstacles. Latest preceding odom/q may differ from exact exporter sample; ages are recorded. No dynamic obstacle term is included.
